action: Immediately pick up maximum viable gig shifts this month — bike delivery via DoorDash and any last-mile delivery work that does not require a car. RoboRide's residential delivery expansion makes this viable as a last-mile layer: the robotaxi brings the package close, I deliver the final block. Research the RoboRide delivery partner registration process this week — if it pays better than DoorDash bike routes, shift hours toward it. Target: 15 to 20 hours of gig work per week across evenings and weekends, carefully scheduled so it does not conflict with Tuesday/Thursday evening classes and Saturday morning class. This is not a career pivot. This is survival. The goal is to generate $400 to $600 this month — enough to stop the savings bleed while I stay enrolled in the cert program. At $1,180 in savings and $1,200/month in essentials, I have less than one month of runway. This is the constraint that overrides everything except keeping my cert streak alive.
